_about: SYNTHETIC test cases for copilot/checks/tpl_check.py. Every member, carrier and amount is invented. Expected outputs are written by hand, not generated by the code.

cases.about: Medicaid billed first while other insurance was active

findings.explanation: Medicaid pays last. COMMERCIAL-Y coverage was active on the date of service, and the claim has no payment information from it.

notes: Bill COMMERCIAL-Y first, then resubmit with its payment details. If that coverage has ended, ask the payer to update its other-coverage record.

cases.about: Primary paid $80 of a $120 Medicaid allowed amount: Medicaid pays at most $40

notes: Under a typical lesser-of method, Medicaid pays at most its allowed amount minus what the primary paid: $120.00 - $80.00 = $40.00. State methods vary.

cases.about: Primary paid more than Medicaid allows: Medicaid pays nothing, never a negative amount

notes: Under a typical lesser-of method, Medicaid pays at most its allowed amount minus what the primary paid: $100.00 - $150.00 = $0.00. State methods vary.

cases.about: Denied for other insurance, but that coverage ended before the service: the denial doesn't hold

notes: Denied for other insurance (22), but no other coverage was active on the date of service. Ask the payer to update its other-coverage record, then resubmit.

cases.about: Commercial claim; the other coverage is secondary, so this payer is correctly first
Commercial claim billed as primary when another plan is primary (general COB)

findings.explanation: COMMERCIAL-Y is primary on the date of service, and the claim has no payment information from it.

notes: Bill COMMERCIAL-Y first, then resubmit with its payment details. If that coverage has ended, ask the payer to update its other-coverage record.

cases.about: For Medicaid, even coverage listed as 'secondary' pays first (payer of last resort)

findings.explanation: Medicaid pays last. OTHER-CARRIER-1 coverage was active on the date of service, and the claim has no payment information from it.

notes: Bill OTHER-CARRIER-1 first, then resubmit with its payment details. If that coverage has ended, ask the payer to update its other-coverage record.

cases.about: Primary paid $0 (e.g. applied to its deductible): that IS payment information, so not flagged

notes: Under a typical lesser-of method, Medicaid pays at most its allowed amount minus what the primary paid: $90.00 - $0.00 = $90.00. State methods vary.
